title: helictotrichon sedenense subsp. planifolium
intro: Helictotrichon sedenense subsp. planifolium, commonly known as Blue Oat Grass, is a type of ornamental grass native to Europe. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, inflammation, and gastrointestinal disorders. The health benefits of Helictotrichon sedenense subsp. planifolium include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
